title: Plum Chutney
description: Sugary, sweet, and full of spices like ginger, chili powder, cloves, and cinnamon, this plum chutney condiment recipe is easy to make on the stovetop.
ingredients: 10 medium plums, pitted and chopped, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon chili powder, or to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground cloves, or more to taste

steps.text: Combine plums and sugar in a heavy-bottomed stockpot; cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture turns to liquid, 8 to 10 minutes.

Stir in salt, ginger, chili powder, cloves, and cinnamon; cook over low heat until reaches desired consistency, stirring often to prevent chutney from sticking, about 15 minutes. Taste and adjust spices if needed.
Stir in vinegar; cook over low heat, stirring frequently to prevent burning, 5 minutes. Cool completely, about 30 minutes. Refrigerate and use within 3 to 4 weeks.
